title: Callsun CN120W / CN180W / CN200W / CN275W Series Datasheet (US V1.4)
description: Official US V1.4 datasheet for the Callsun 120W, 180W, 200W and 275W bifacial N-type TOPCon monocrystalline solar module family. Covers electrical parameters, mechanical characteristics, temperature coefficients, certifications (IEC 61215 / 61730, ISO 9001/14001/45001, CE, RoHS), installation guidance, wiring diagrams and warranty policy (10-year product + 25-year linear power, 84.5% output at year 25).
